## AI is included on paid plans. These take it further.

Paid plans include ClickUp Brain² and a monthly credit allowance. When your team wants more, add exactly what you need.

AI Credits

### Add more credits to any paid plan

Paid plans include a pooled monthly allowance for Super Agents, AI Fields, image generation, and more. Top up when you run hot.

Certified Agents

### Expert-built agents for complex workflows

Built, tested, and verified by ClickUp's AI experts. Trained on your processes and data, then continuously maintained by ClickUp.

ClickUp Assist

### Live training and support for AI

Personalized expert guidance for setup and success, including guidance on standing up your first AI agents.

Super Fair Billing policy

## When we optimize, you save $

When our teams save on AI costs, we pass them on to you. When sudden increases in AI costs occur, we subsidize the cost. If AI providers raise rates, we'll adjust pricing gradually and transparently, while continuing to optimize wherever possible.

![Super Agent price per credit - $0.001](https://images.ctfassets.net/w8fc6tgspyjz/2nX0Rz7lhdQXfuIXAcSRCc/1f1dcb50aa0eb84d2b8f4c1300cedfea/agents-price-fair-billing.webp)

## Frequently asked questions

Find answers to your questions right here, and don't hesitate to [Contact us](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us) if you couldn't find what you're looking for.

To upgrade ClickUp, you'll need to upgrade your entire Workspace, which means all members in your Workspace.

Free forever. No credit card.
